alerts.title: Chestnut Hill East Station Parking Lot Update
alerts.text: Only 18 parking spots (including 1 ADA spot) are designated for customers on East Chestnut Hill Ave., alongside the South lot. Additionally, no overnight parking is allowed at Chestnut Hill East Station until construction is completed.

alerts.title: Outbound Platform Boarding, Train #207, Norristown Transit Center
alerts.text: Every weekday until further notice, passengers must board inbound Train #207 departing at 5:50 am on the outbound platform at Norristown Transit Center.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Between Norristown Transit Center and Bridgeport Station
alerts.text: Bus service replaces train service from Norristown Transit Center to Bridgeport Station through December 19. Passengers should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.title: 11th St Station Closed
alerts.text: 11th St and the 11th St concourse is closed to fast-track elevator construction and renovations. Please use 13th St during construction. For more information, visit SEPTA.org.

alerts.title: 8th-Market Station Elevator to Eastbound Platform Out of Service
alerts.text: The elevator at 8th-Market Station to the eastbound platform is out of service until mid-December. For accessible eastbound travel, please use 5th St/Independence Hall Station.

alerts.title: Notice of Bus Stop Change
alerts.text: The eastbound stop at Washington Ave & Moyamensing Ave is closed. Use nearby stop at Washington Ave & 3rd St.

alerts.title: Notice of Bus Stop Changes
alerts.text: Stops at Front & Ellsworth, Washington & 4th and Moyamensing & 2nd are closed. Use nearby stops at Washington Ave & Front, 3rd or 5th.

alerts.title: Potential Delays due to Amtrak Infrastructure Project
alerts.text: Due to an Amtrak infrastructure project near William H. Gray III 30th St Station: Paoli/Thorndale, Cynwyd, Trenton, Chestnut Hill West, Fox Chase and West Trenton trains may experience delays of up to 10 minutes through early November. Please plan for added travel time. SEPTA apologizes for the inconvenience.

alerts.title: Outbound Platform Boarding from Noble to Neshaminy Falls Stations
alerts.text: On weekdays from Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 20, from 9:30 am to 2 pm daily, passengers must board on the outbound platforms from Noble to Neshaminy Falls stations.

alerts.title: Outbound Platform Boarding Jenkintown-Wyncote Station
alerts.text: On weekdays from Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 20, from 9:30 am to 2 pm daily, passengers must board on the outbound platform at Jenkintown-Wyncote Station.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Between 63rd-Girard Station and Richmond-Westmoreland Station
alerts.text: Bus service replaces trolley service for the entirety of the G from Monday, November 9, through Wednesday, November 11.

alerts.title: Southbound Platform Boarding Snyder and Oregon Stations
alerts.text: From Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13, from 10 pm until the end of service daily, passengers must board on the southbound platforms at Snyder and Oregon stations.

alerts.title: Trolley Service Suspended Between Providence Road and Orange Street Stations
alerts.text: Trolley service is suspended from Providence Road to Orange Street Stations from 7:30 am to 3 pm on Wednesday, November 11, due to the Media Veterans Day Parade.

alerts.title: Southbound Platform Boarding Township Line Rd to Wynnewood Rd Stations
alerts.text: From Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13, from 9:30 am to 3 pm daily, passengers must board on the southbound platforms from Township Line Rd to Wynnewood Rd stations.

alerts.title: Westbound Platform Boarding 34th St and 40th St Stations
alerts.text: Beginning 10 pm Friday, November 13, through Sunday, November 15, passengers must board on the westbound platforms at 34th St and 40th St stations.

alerts.title: Shuttle Busing Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St Stations
alerts.text: Bus service replaces trains from Conshohocken to Norristown - Elm St stations on November 14-15. Riders should allow an additional 10-15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit septa.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate Manayunk/Norristown Shuttle Bus schedule page.

alerts.title: Monthly Saturday Shuttle Busing 69th St Transit Center to Media/Sharon Hill
alerts.text: To conduct overhead wire inspections and maintenance, shuttle buses replace trolley service on the first Saturday of each month until further notice. Riders should allow an additional 15 minutes for travel. For details and schedules, visit SEPTA.org. Shuttle bus information is available on a separate D1 bus & D2 bus schedule pages.

alerts.title: Eastbound Platform Boarding Baltimore Ave to Drexel Hill Junction Stations
alerts.text: From Monday, November 9 through Friday, November 13, from 9:30 am to 3 pm daily, passengers must board on the eastbound platforms from Baltimore Avenue to Drexel Hill Junction stations.
